general.summary: Polish cloud infrastructure provider CloudFerro SA is considering an initial public offering in Warsaw as soon as next year, according to people familiar with the matter.

general.title: Anthropic Falls After Blockbuster Debut as Tech Sells Off
general.summary: Anthropic shares erased much of their first-day surge as the record-breaking listing faces its first test from public investors. Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary discusses what's ahead for the company with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Altruist’s Wenk on AI and the Next Era of Financial Advice
general.summary: Altruist CEO Jason Wenk joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld for a wide ranging conversation on what joining Vanguard could mean for Altruist, his push to make financial advice more accessible and how technology and AI could reshape the economics of wealth management. He also addresses the future of the RIA custody market and Altruist’s plans to expand its product offering. Wenk spoke at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth conference in New York on November 19, 2026. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: GTA VI Earns Near-Perfect Reviews in Record Launch
general.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI has finally arrived — and Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier calls it a “masterpiece” after spending more than 45 hours with the game. He discusses the extraordinary detail and scale of Rockstar’s latest blockbuster, the record demand surrounding its launch and how GTA VI earned a 99 score on Metacritic, making it the highest-rated game ever on the review aggregator. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
